chunks.text: Acme Corp achieved record-breaking performance in FY2024, with revenue growing 23% year-over-year to reach $125 million. This marks our eighth consecutive year of double-digit growth.

Revenue: $101M ﬁ $125M (+23%) Net Income: $18M ﬁ $24M (+33%) Employees: 1,087 ﬁ 1,250 (+15%) Customers: 4,200 ﬁ 5,500 (+31%) NPS: 65 ﬁ 72

2, Quarterly Financials

All figures in millions: Q1 FY24: Revenue $26M, Net Income $4.5M Q2 FY24: Revenue $28M, Net Income $5M Q3 FY24: Revenue $32M, Net Income $6.5M Q4 FY24: Revenue $39M, Net Income $9M
